Campaign: programs/dclutch-trading-sbf/program-test/tests/direct_hot_fee_pair.rs, seven tests, run by tools/gauntlet/direct-fee-pair/run-direct-fee-pair.sh. WHY THIS CAMPAIGN EXISTS: both Trading routes below executed on real ELFs for days and were NEVER-EXECUTED to the census the whole time, because no bindings.json named them -- UNWITNESSED_ROUTES_BY_ROW_2026_09_01.md lists both among C-04's four. The gap was the campaign wrapper, never the route. EVERY ROW IS AUTHORED FROM FOLDED EVIDENCE, never from what the campaign ought to touch: the label is the libtest thread name plus that test's submission ordinal plus a disposition read back from the runtime, so a refusal that changes code changes binding instead of quietly reusing one. Child routes are deliberately NOT bound: the invoke log names the child PROGRAM at depth 2 but not which selector ran inside it, and a binding this campaign cannot corroborate is worse than an absent one. EVERY transaction reports wire_bytes -- docs/design/PACKET_LIMIT_2026_09_01.md records that no C-04 program-test did, and ProgramTest submits no packet, so the 1,232-byte maximum is measured here rather than enforced by the runtime.
